name: NintyShell
description: Local shell and SSH/SFTP terminals in the DBX workbench: run commands and manage remote files.
releaseNotes: Windows support for the Local Shell connection (auto-selected powershell.exe, command wrapper with exit-code and working-directory reporting) and platform-aware shell defaults; panic log moved from /tmp to the user cache directory with tightened permissions; collapsible activity log in the file panel.

zh-CN.name: NintyShell
zh-CN.description: 在 DBX 工作台中打开本地 Shell 与 SSH/SFTP 终端，执行命令并管理远程文件。
